text:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — we're gating the tenant prefetch + HSM/KMS pilot for next month. Need cross-team agreement on launch gates: capacity slots, KMS SLA, and an emergency rollback path. Can the owners confirm criteria by EOD Fri?

Devon (Eng): Noted. From eng side we need: 1) canary route with 1% traffic, 2) perf benchmarking with 95th p50/p95 targets, 3) feature flag to flip prefetch off.

Priya (Runtime): We can add a canary variant on runtime and measure KV cache hit-rate. Will need a dedicated GPU slot for the canary during the first week. Can we reserve 1 dedicated slot? :thinking_face:

Sam (Infra): We have limited capacity that week — what GPU SKU do you need? Also HSM onboarding is a separate procurement flow. If you need a guaranteed slot we should swap with another low-priority pilot or schedule prewarm windows.

Tess (Security): HSM/KMS checklist: 1) key policy reviewed, 2) audit logging enabled, 3) threat model signoff. I can review key policy but need the HSM vendor contact + config by Thu.

Maya (Product): Priya: request g4dnx or A100-equivalent for stable perf. Sam: can you do a short feasibility check on capacity swap? Tess: I'll DM vendor info now.

Chris (SRE): Also call out rollback SLOs. If canary error rate > 2% for 15m, we auto-failover to fallback model variant. We'll need a runbook entry and a circuit-breaker in the router.

Devon (Eng): Agreed on circuit-breaker. Proposed canary policy snippet:
```
canary: {
  percent: 1,
  monitoring: ["latency_p95", "error_rate"],
  thresholds: {latency_p95_ms: 250, error_rate_pct: 2},
  failure_window_min: 15
}
```
Would need runtime to understand the ``percent`` header and infra to route.

Priya (Runtime): We can interpret that header. Two notes: 1) percent-based routing increases tail latencies from dynamic batching — we'll instrument both with and without batching. 2) If KV-caching warms differently for canary, results may be noisy first 30m. Recommend a prewarm step: run synthetic traffic for 20m.

Sam (Infra): Capacity swap looks feasible if we shift 'batchsmart' pilot to a later slot. I'll confirm by EOD. Prewarm windows OK but we need a scheduled maintenance window to avoid overcommitting.

Tess (Security): Received vendor contact. I'll run key policy review and add the audit log queries we need. Action: I'll add required log retention and PR for IAM roles before Wed.

Maya (Product): Nice. Owners & action items:
- Devon (Eng): draft canary/runbook + API flag for prefetch (due Thu)
- Priya (Runtime): prewarm script + perf baseline (due Thu)
- Sam (Infra): capacity swap confirmation + schedule window (due EOD Fri)
- Tess (Security): key policy review + IAM PR (due Wed)
- Chris (SRE): circuit-breaker routing + alerting (due Thu)

Maya (Product): If any of the above slips, we move pilot by one week. Please @mention if you need help unblocking procurement or support tickets.

Devon (Eng): I'll start the runbook doc and post a short checklist here when done.

Priya (Runtime): Posting prewarm command for visibility:
```bash
# synthetic prewarm (20m)
./rt-run --target tenant-pilot --duration 1200 --qps 5 --payload sample.json
```
This will warm KV and batch paths.

Sam (Infra): Confirmed: can free a slot by shifting batchsmart; will post maintenance window times.

Tess (Security): Key policy review scheduled Thu 3pm. Will post blockers immediately.

Chris (SRE): I'll add the monitor to the router and wire alerts to #eng-oncall. Expected to be quick.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary route will be created after the canary flag is added by dev.

Maya (Product): Great sync. If everyone hits owners' dates we should be green for a soft-launch the following week. I'll send a short stakeholder note after EOD. :rocket:
